# AI Database Sandbox

> In-browser virtual MySQL/MariaDB behavioral sandbox for AI agents, testing, simulation, and automated verification. Powered by Core 1.2.

This project does not connect to or run a real MySQL/MariaDB server.

## Start here
- README: ./README.md
- Agent instructions: ./AGENTS.md
- Machine-readable AI manifest: ./ai-manifest.json
- AI Control API guide: ./docs/AI-USAGE.md
- Architecture: ./docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
- Capability manifest: ./evidence/capability-manifest.json
- Compatibility: ./evidence/sandbox-compatibility.json
- Latest verification status: ./evidence/FINAL-STATUS.json

## Source
- Core baseline: ./core/core-1.2.0-r8-p1.js
- Virtual DB engine: ./sandbox/virtual-db.js
- AI Control API: ./sandbox/ai-sandbox-api.js
- Browser UI: ./index.html

## Tests
- Regression: `npm test`
- AI API: `npm run test:ai`
- Node verification: `npm run verify:node`
- Final browser verification: `npm run verify:final`

## Important rule
Read `evidence/capability-manifest.json` before generating SQL. Features marked PARTIAL, NOT_SUPPORTED, or NOT_TESTED must not be presented as fully verified.
